title: Version directive fences in option documentation

note.title: Version directive fences in option documentation
answers: How should I document when an option was added?
How should I mark a change to an option in the docs?
What fence syntax should versionadded and versionchanged use?
note.body:
Convention: docs/options.md uses triple-backtick fences for versionadded and versionchanged directives.
Syntax: Put the directive name in braces and its version on the opening line, such as ```{versionadded} 4.0; close with ```.
Constraint: Use this form for these version annotations in option documentation; avoid ::: fences.
note.applies: Version-added and version-changed annotations in docs/options.md.
